## Setup required
1. Select a RapidAPI header credential on **Fetch Jobs (JSearch)**.
2. Create a header-auth credential on **Send Batch to Job Agent** with header `X-Job-Agent-Webhook-Token` and the one-time source token.
3. Replace `sourceId`, `jobAgentBaseUrl`, `query`, and optional `searchRuleId` in **Configure Source**.
4. Test manually before activating the hourly schedule.

The application database is the system of record. This workflow maps and sends every returned job (up to 100); it does not write only the first row to Google Sheets.
